New canned reply: "That's outside what I cover — I stick to how we run the stores. For pay, schedules, HR, legal or money questions, check with <store manager>." Prompt NEVER list extended to match. - **Rule (from the December 2026 bonus month):** a bonus is earned only if the store meets every standard KPI in force on the 1st (every measurable standard in the P&P, Handbook, store scorecard or a signed Monthly Policy Update) plus the bonus goals; one employee's own documented violation affects only that employee; CEO approves every bonus (approval = conditions met, not a second test); a store/position/company program can be suspended for a legitimate business reason by written notice, for months that begin after the notice; earned bonuses are always paid; bonuses count in the OT regular rate. ## 2026-10-21 (Do BrightLocal aggregators move the needle? — measured)

- Natural experiment: CUL/ROA/HAR aggregators expired late Nov 2025; WAY stayed active (control). Non-brand city searches ("pawn shop <city>" etc.), avg impressions/month, Aug–Oct 2025 → Jun–Sep 2026: CUL 264 → 251 (−5%), ROA 1,160 → 1,174 (+1%), HAR 563 → 605 (+7%), WAY (active) 315 → 329 (+4%).
